functions.description: Parse base ESXi Clusteragent log line into timestamp, host, thread id, severity, component and message
Extract vCenter source IP from configuration update messages
Extract master node destination IP and port from heartbeat/SSL/reconnect messages
Extract user and source IP from authentication failure messages
Extract user from successful authentication messages

add.name: action
add.value: message.includes('Authentication failure') ? 'blocked' : message.includes('authenticated successfully') ? 'allowed' : message.includes('Network partition') ? 'isolated' : message.includes('elected') || message.includes('Master election') ? 'elected' : 'info'

functions.description: Normalize action classification and protocol based on message content and severity

add.name: dest_ip
add.value: dest_ip || dst_ip || destination__ip || server__ip || dstaddr || dstip

add.name: dest_port
add.value: dest_port || dst_port || destination__port || dpt || dstport || dport

add.name: log_time
add.value: log_time || generated_time || receive_time || start_time || event__created || timestamp || event__start

functions.description: Alias Copilot/schematizer OCSF-style fields to canonical names

add.name: _time
add.value: (typeof log_time != 'undefined' && log_time) ? (/^\d{13}$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) : /^\d{10}$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) * 1000 : /^\d{13}\.\d+$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) : /^\d{10}\.\d+$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) * 1000 : new Date(String(log_time)).getTime()) / 1000 : _time

functions.description: Set _time from the parsed timestamp (log_time), if one was captured

add.name: src_endpoint
add.value: (((src_ip || srcaddr || srcip || src) != null && String(src_ip || srcaddr || srcip || src) != 'undefined' && String(src_ip || srcaddr || srcip || src) != 'null' && String(src_ip || srcaddr || srcip || src) != '-' && String(src_ip || srcaddr || srcip || src) != '')) ? {} : undefined

add.name: dst_endpoint
add.value: (((dest_ip || dst_ip || dstaddr || dstip || dst) != null && String(dest_ip || dst_ip || dstaddr || dstip || dst) != 'undefined' && String(dest_ip || dst_ip || dstaddr || dstip || dst) != 'null' && String(dest_ip || dst_ip || dstaddr || dstip || dst) != '-' && String(dest_ip || dst_ip || dstaddr || dstip || dst) != '')) ? {} : undefined

add.name: actor
add.value: (((user || src_user || suser || username) != null && String(user || src_user || suser || username) != 'undefined' && String(user || src_user || suser || username) != 'null' && String(user || src_user || suser || username) != '-' && String(user || src_user || suser || username) != '')) ? {} : undefined

add.name: actor.user
add.value: (((user || src_user || suser || username) != null && String(user || src_user || suser || username) != 'undefined' && String(user || src_user || suser || username) != 'null' && String(user || src_user || suser || username) != '-' && String(user || src_user || suser || username) != '')) ? {} : undefined

add.name: device
add.value: (((host || hostname || devname || dvchost) != null && String(host || hostname || devname || dvchost) != 'undefined' && String(host || hostname || devname || dvchost) != 'null' && String(host || hostname || devname || dvchost) != '-' && String(host || hostname || devname || dvchost) != '')) ? {} : undefined

add.name: src_endpoint.ip
add.value: (src_ip || srcaddr || srcip || src) != null && String(src_ip || srcaddr || srcip || src) != 'undefined' && String(src_ip || srcaddr || srcip || src) != 'null' && String(src_ip || srcaddr || srcip || src) != '-' && String(src_ip || srcaddr || srcip || src) != '' ? (src_ip || srcaddr || srcip || src) : undefined

add.name: dst_endpoint.ip
add.value: (dest_ip || dst_ip || dstaddr || dstip || dst) != null && String(dest_ip || dst_ip || dstaddr || dstip || dst) != 'undefined' && String(dest_ip || dst_ip || dstaddr || dstip || dst) != 'null' && String(dest_ip || dst_ip || dstaddr || dstip || dst) != '-' && String(dest_ip || dst_ip || dstaddr || dstip || dst) != '' ? (dest_ip || dst_ip || dstaddr || dstip || dst) : undefined

add.name: actor.user.name
add.value: (user || src_user || suser || username) != null && String(user || src_user || suser || username) != 'undefined' && String(user || src_user || suser || username) != 'null' && String(user || src_user || suser || username) != '-' && String(user || src_user || suser || username) != '' ? (user || src_user || suser || username) : undefined

add.name: device.hostname
add.value: (host || hostname || devname || dvchost) != null && String(host || hostname || devname || dvchost) != 'undefined' && String(host || hostname || devname || dvchost) != 'null' && String(host || hostname || devname || dvchost) != '-' && String(host || hostname || devname || dvchost) != '' ? (host || hostname || devname || dvchost) : undefined

add.name: message
add.value: (message || msg || _raw) != null && String(message || msg || _raw) != 'undefined' && String(message || msg || _raw) != 'null' && String(message || msg || _raw) != '-' && String(message || msg || _raw) != '' ? (message || msg || _raw) : undefined
